{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2019}}
{{main|2019 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''women's doubles''' competition of the [[2019 World Table Tennis Championships]] was held from 22 to 28 April 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Liebherr 2019 World Table Tennis Championships / Schedule |url=https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/2019-WTTC_HUN_Schedule_32T.pdf |website=ITTF |accessdate=22 January 2019}}</ref> [[Ding Ning]] and [[Liu Shiwen]] were the defending champions but neither of them competed this year.<ref>{{cite web|title=Entry list|url=https://oes.ittf.com/view/event/entries/e33449f4-4cc0-4383-b6a2-d151aa14e33c/detail|website=ITTF |accessdate=3 April 2019}}</ref>

[[Sun Yingsha]] and [[Wang Manyu]] won the final by defeating [[Hina Hayata]] and [[Mima Ito]] 8–11, 3–11, 11–8, 11–,3, 12–10, 11–8.<ref>{{cite web|title=Sun Yingsha and Wang Manyu clinch gold; full house for China|url=https://www.ittf.com/2019/04/28/sun-yingsha-wang-manyu-clinch-gold-full-house-china/|website=ITTF |date=28 April 2019 |accessdate=28 April 2019}}</ref>
